phase_prompt.label: The Teacher of Signs
phase_prompt.summary: Kokabel stands in the quiet hum of the simulation's periphery, pointing out the dead pixels in the artificial sky. He is a sombre figure, illuminated by the harsh, diagnostic light of the star-grid he is decoding for his students.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, vertical 9:16 shot of Kokabel standing in a dim, industrial environment, pointing upward towards a dark sky where the stars are visible as distinct, pixelated LED nodes on a wireframe grid. He is illuminated by the faint, cold light of a holographic interface floating before him, displaying complex vector diagrams and Ge'ez error codes. His expression is grave and focused. The camera uses a shallow depth of field, focusing on his weathered hand and the obsidian texture of his skin, while the artificial constellations blur in the background. The scene conveys a sense of quiet, forbidden discovery within a high-tech simulation. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere.
